response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang backend experience, but the role requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, and AI accelerator performance optimization. There is no evidence of hardware-software co-design, GPU/SIMD architecture work, or deep-learning workload analysis. Despite meeting years-of-experience thresholds, the domain mismatch is fundamental for a Principal-level hardware performance architect role.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (15+ years) across many stacks
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching in DLang)
Bachelor's in Computer Science with strong open-source and community contributions
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No deep-learning training/inference or GPU workload analysis background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not performance architecture or hardware-software co-design
